notes: name streams are provably delimited (NUL-terminated tokens, gap<=8B)
record tables are provably delimited (16B u64 pairs, values < 0x4000000)
blocks are provably delimited by the (u32 0, u32 payload_bytes) trailers
record law: u64 byte_offset + u64 fp16_element_count, tensor body is 2*count bytes inside the block payload (verified for 4/5 blocks)

payload bases come from the six (const float16_t*, uint32_t) getters in .text (adrp+add;ret / movz+movk;ret) consumed by the model loader at 0xafbc4; each block is joined to a payload by its trailer size

the operator graph (NetDef) is NOT in this binary: no protobuf framing exists in .rodata and the description blocks are referenced by no instruction/relocation, so operator wiring and per-tensor shapes cannot be reconstructed (see GAP_CLOSURE.md)
